# Recap: our call on 22 October 2026

## Today
You are starting baking classes in the spring, about six a week with twelve seats each, and the paper diary cannot take bookings and payments for them. You have found about four booking tools and do not yet have a fair way to compare them.

## What needs to change
Classes book and pay online on their own, with a tool you chose for reasons you can show your business partner.

## Next step
I recommend help choosing the tool: we agree the criteria and their weights with you first, then compare the tools on evidence, and I write a recommendation; you make the choice. If you say yes, I'll send a short scope with a fixed quote for the selection.

## What I need from you
- The names of the tools you have looked at, so the comparison starts from your list.

Robin
